description: A toy store decides to deliver gifts using two shipping companies, a new one and an old one. The new company can deliver 50 gifts per trip while the old company can deliver 70 gifts per trip. The new company uses 30 liters of diesel per trip while the old company uses 40 liters of diesel per trip. The toy store needs to deliver at least 1000 gifts. There can be at most 15 trips made by the new company. In order to make sure that the old company does not go out of business, at least 40% of all trips must be made by the old company. How many trips should each company make to minimize the total amount of diesel used?

NewCompanyCapacity.definition: Delivery capacity per trip of the new shipping company

OldCompanyCapacity.definition: Delivery capacity per trip of the old shipping company

NewCompanyDiesel.definition: Diesel consumption per trip of the new shipping company

OldCompanyDiesel.definition: Diesel consumption per trip of the old shipping company

MinimumGifts.definition: Minimum number of gifts to deliver

MaxTripsNewCompany.definition: Maximum number of trips by the new shipping company

MinimumOldCompanyTripPercentage.definition: Minimum percentage of trips that must be made by the old shipping company

objective.description: "Minimize the total amount of diesel used by the new and old shipping companies for delivering the gifts"

constraints.description: 50 * (number of trips by new company) + 70 * (number of trips by old company) >= 1000
Number of trips by new company <= 15
3 * (number of trips by old company) >= 2 * (number of trips by new company)
Number of trips by new company >= 0
Number of trips by new company and number of trips by old company must be integers
